cases.old:

			Set("scheduled", true).
			Where(sq.Eq{"id": build.ID()}).
cases.new:

			Set("scheduled", false).

tests: Job ScheduleBuild when the scheduling build is created first when the job config doesn't specify max in flight when build exists when the pipeline and job is not paused sets the build to scheduled
Job ScheduleBuild when the scheduling build is created first when the job config doesn't specify max in flight when build exists when the pipeline is paused returns false
Job ScheduleBuild when the scheduling build is created first when the job config doesn't specify max in flight when build exists when the job is paused returns false
Job ScheduleBuild when the scheduling build is not the first one created (with serial groups) when the job is paused but has inputs determined does not schedule the build
Job ScheduleBuild when the scheduling build is created first when the job config doesn't specify max in flight when the build does not exist returns false
Job a build is created for a job and another build for a different pipeline is created with the same job name does not change the next pending build for job
Job a build is created for a job when scheduled remains the next pending build for job

cases.old: OrderBy("COALESCE(b.rerun_of, b.rerun_of_old, b.id) ASC, b.id ASC").
cases.new: OrderBy("COALESCE(b.rerun_of, b.rerun_of_old, b.id) DESC, b.id DESC").
tests: Job a build is created for a job and another is created for the same job the first build remains the next pending build
Job a build is created for a job when there is a rerun build created for an old build orders the builds with regular build first and then rerun of old build
Job a build is created for a job when there is a rerun build created for the newest build orders the builds with rerun of new build
Job a build is created for a job when there are multiple reruns for multiple pending builds orders the builds with ascending reruns following original builds
Job a build is created for a job when started saves the updated status, and the schema and private plan
Job a build is created for a job when started saves the build's start time
